description: Selects exactly one atomic Rigwright workflow. Use when a request involves creating, improving, evaluating, migrating, prioritizing, or archiving a skill or plugin and the correct narrow Rigwright leaf must be chosen.
intent: Select one eligible Rigwright leaf for the request.
outcome: Return exactly one leaf identifier, or a bounded clarification or block when no leaf is eligible.
non_goals: Evaluate, migrate, prioritize, archive, install, activate, or publish
outputs: One selected leaf identifier or bounded no-selection result

permissions.allowed_scope: Read request and eligible Rigwright metadata only

positive: which Rigwright workflow should handle this
evaluate migrate prioritize or archive a skill

lifecycle.promotion_gate: Paired cross-surface routing and collision evidence plus owner approval

instructions: Classify the requested action as route, author-skill, author-plugin, evaluate, migrate, prioritize, or archive.
Reject any leaf that is ineligible under the supplied lifecycle context.
Select exactly one narrow leaf; ask one bounded clarification only when two outcomes would materially differ.
Return the selected leaf and a one-sentence scope reason, then delegate without repeating its procedure.
Return BLOCKED when the request requires an unimplemented future MCP, agent, hook, command, or app authoring leaf.
